citation: Khan Sullivan AM, Isherwood CM, Hassanin H, et al. Diurnal Variation and Impairment of Postprandial Glucose‐Insulin Responses and Lipid Rhythms in Simulated Shift Work. Nutrition Bulletin. 2026.
protocol: Simulated shift work in lab: day shift (sleep 23:00-07:00; four identical isoenergetic meals at 08:00, 13:00, 18:00, 22:00) followed by two night-shift days with 10 h delayed sleep and meals; serial blood sampling
population: n=9 healthy non-shift workers (6 M, 3 F), age 21-33 (mean 28.8+/-3.1) y, BMI 25+/-2

reports.where: Table 1 (model-derived mean by shift) and Table 2 (acrophase, amplitude)

note: Use the day-shift condition as the controlled 24 h meal+sleep arm; night-shift arms are circadian misalignment. Table 1 gives model-derived means with 95% CI; text states SEM elsewhere. Glucose in mmol/L, insulin in uU/mL.
